title: Crypto’s $168 million election: 78 winners, 13 newcomers and one costly defeat
summary: Crypto super PACs backed 78 candidates who have won seats in Congress. Just 13 of them will enter Congress for the first time. Most of the winning roster already has a record in Washington.
